title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents and find DRS scores of 19.2--45.1, with the lowest scores on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents obtain lower task success with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average). For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6--3.5 points. Together, these findings highlight the challenges of reliable asynchronous task execution and the need to evaluate how agents handle incoming results alongside end-to-end task success. 1 1 1 Data and code are available at: https://pope8zdt.github.io/Async-RBench
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地以异步方式执行任务：主智能体在其子智能体运行期间继续工作，而在子智能体的结果到达之前，任务状态可能已经发生变化。 主智能体必须决定更新或保留哪些工作、重复哪些检查，同时避免做出被禁止的更改。 仅凭最终任务的成功并不能揭示这些结果是否被正确处理，而自然发生的异步到达也难以复现。 我们提出 Async-RBench，一个面向 LLM 智能体异步任务执行的基准，包含 200 个可执行任务，覆盖八种场景。 场景控制器依据预定义的任务状态条件来调控结果的交付，而事件响应契约（ERC）则规定每次响应必须更改什么、保留什么、避免什么以及重新验证什么。 动态重规划分数（DRS）对响应过程与结果赋予同等权重，并与任务成功指标分开报告。 我们评估了九个智能体，发现其 DRS 分数为 19.2--45.1，其中在重复报告和子智能体失败方面得分最低。 在我们的执行协议下，与批量交付相比，所有九个智能体在异步交付下的任务成功率都更低（平均 26.0% 对 29.7%）。 对于三个智能体，提示主智能体在每次结果到达后重建其计划，仅能将 DRS 提升 2.6--3.5 分。 这些发现共同凸显了可靠异步任务执行的挑战，并表明除了端到端任务成功之外，还需要评估智能体如何处理传入的结果。1 1 1 数据和代码见：https://pope8zdt.github.io/Async-RBench

paragraphs.en: Main–subagent architectures are increasingly common in large language model (LLM) agents: a main agent decomposes tasks, delegates subtasks to subagents, and integrates their results ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Masters et al., 2025 ) . Subagents can run with separate contexts, specialized roles ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) , tools, and instructions ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) , and production coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex provide built-in support for subagents ( Anthropic, n.d. ; OpenAI, n.d. ) . Rather than idling until every subagent finishes, the main agent can keep working and consume results asynchronously as they arrive. We call such an arrival during ongoing execution an asynchronous interruption .
paragraphs.zh: 主智能体–子智能体架构在大语言模型（LLM）智能体中日益常见：主智能体对任务进行分解，将子任务委派给子智能体，并整合它们的结果（Fourney et al., 2024；Masters et al., 2025）。 子智能体可以使用独立的上下文、专门的角色（Hong et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2024；Li et al., 2023）、工具和指令来运行（Wu et al., 2024；Gao et al., 2024），并且 Claude Code 和 Codex 等生产级编码智能体为子智能体提供了内置支持（Anthropic, n.d.；OpenAI, n.d.）。 主智能体无需闲置等待所有子智能体完成，而是可以持续工作，并在结果到达时异步地消费它们。 我们把这种在执行过程中发生的到达称为异步中断。

paragraphs.en: The task state may change between a subagent’s launch and the arrival of its result ( Ginart et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . By the time a result arrives, the main agent may already have committed to a plan, written artifacts, or run validation, and the right response depends on how the result relates to that state. A late authoritative result must be acted on and may invalidate earlier work. A stale or duplicate report may require leaving valid work unchanged and avoiding repeated side effects. If a subagent fails, the main agent must recover the affected subtask while preserving valid work on other subtasks ( Geng & Chang, 2025 ) . In Figure 1 , subagent B’s cleanup changes the code base after subagent A has reported passing tests, so A’s report no longer verifies the repository, although no message flags it as outdated. Responding correctly means adapting the patch to the new base, keeping C’s server setup, and rerunning the affected tests; reusing A’s report leaves the new release unverified. A correct response makes the changes required by a subagent result, preserves valid progress, avoids prohibited side effects, and performs the required validation. Correctness requires both making necessary changes and avoiding unnecessary ones. These errors are not symmetric in cost: ignoring a result that invalidates earlier work leaves artifacts the agent’s own evidence no longer supports, whereas rebuilding work the result does not affect repeats side effects, discards verified artifacts, and spends calls the remaining task still needs.
paragraphs.zh: 任务状态可能在某个子智能体启动与其结果到达之间发生变化（Ginart 等，2024；Yang 等，2026）。 当结果到达时，主智能体可能已经确定计划、写入了产物或运行了验证，而正确的响应取决于该结果与此状态的关系。 迟到的权威结果必须被执行，并可能使先前的工作失效。 过时或重复的报告则可能要求保持有效工作不变，并避免重复的副作用。 如果某个子智能体失败，主智能体必须恢复受影响的子任务，同时保留其他子任务上的有效工作（Geng & Chang，2025）。 在图 1 中，子智能体 B 的清理在子智能体 A 报告测试通过之后改变了代码库，因此 A 的报告不再能验证该仓库，尽管没有任何消息将其标记为过时。 正确的响应意味着让补丁适配新的基础代码、保留 C 的服务器配置，并重新运行受影响的测试；复用 A 的报告则会让新版本处于未验证状态。 正确的响应会执行子智能体结果所要求的更改、保留有效进展、避免被禁止的副作用，并执行所需的验证。 正确性既要求做出必要的更改，也要求避免不必要的更改。 这些错误的代价并不对称：忽略一个使先前工作失效的结果，会留下智能体自身证据已不再支持的产物；而重建一个结果并未影响的工作，则会重复副作用、丢弃已验证的产物，并消耗剩余任务仍然需要的调用次数。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks do not isolate this capability. Evaluations of interruptible, dynamic, and multi-agent systems inject disruptions through user instructions ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Rana et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , environment events ( Froger et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) , interrupted execution ( Gulati, 2026 ; KC & Budathoki, 2026 ) , or tool and delegation failures ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) , most of which make explicit that something must be handled. A subagent result may not explicitly indicate that earlier work has become invalid. The main agent must assess the result’s validity, recency, and scope to decide whether existing work needs to change. The closest benchmark includes subagent reports but neither specifies per-event response requirements nor separates event response from task success ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . Evaluation poses two further obstacles. First, final task success alone cannot distinguish correct event handling from success or failure elsewhere in the task. An agent may handle an event correctly yet fail another requirement, or pass the final checks despite repeating a side effect. Second, asynchronous execution is nondeterministic. Subagent results may reach the main agent unpredictably, making responses difficult to compare across runs and agents.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Async-RBench , a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks adapted from Terminal-Bench, Gaia2, OSWorld, SWE-bench, and MultiAgentBench ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Froger et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025a ) . The tasks evenly cover eight interruption scenarios, ranging from delayed authoritative results and stale updates to duplicate reports and subagent failures (Table 2 ). Subagents execute concurrently in isolated workspaces. A scenario controller buffers results and applies case-specific release conditions, with a maximum-hold fallback to avoid deadlock. Therefore, each task’s target event reaches the main agent under designed preconditions rather than natural timing (Figure 2 ). Each target event has an Event Response Contract (ERC) available only to the evaluator. It specifies required changes, valid work to preserve, prohibited side effects, validation evidence, and the expected outcome, without prescribing a unique action sequence. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and the event outcome equally and is reported separately from end-to-end task success S S .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate nine agents and report three findings: (1) Handling asynchronous results remains challenging. Overall DRS ranges from 19.2 to 45.1, with the lowest scenario means on Duplication and replay (8.6) and Subagent failure (12.2). (2) Task success is lower under asynchronous delivery. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents have lower task success rate estimates with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average), and eight consume more tokens. Selected paired traces illustrate two failure patterns under Async: the main agent terminates before integrating required artifacts, or acts on assumptions before inspecting the underlying task evidence. (3) Mandatory plan rebuilding yields limited gains. Full-rebuild prompts the main agent to rebuild its remaining plan after every subagent result. For the three agents evaluated, it improves DRS by only 2.6–3.5 points while increasing model calls by 7.5–10.2%. Together, these findings highlight the difficulty of reliable asynchronous task execution. By evaluating event responses separately from end-to-end task success, Async-RBench provides a basis for comparing agents and assessing improvements in this setting.

paragraphs.en: Many agent benchmarks pose a task and emphasize task-level outcomes, covering general assistance ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ) , web and mobile interfaces ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) , tool use with users ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , and long-context or MCP-based workflows ( Li et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Multi-agent benchmarks extend this to collaboration and competition among agents ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) and to orchestration plans evaluated in deterministic simulation ( Ren et al., 2026 ) . Other benchmarks provide complementary checks. AgentBoard measures intermediate progress ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , ToolSandbox checks milestones along the trajectory ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , and AppWorld checks for unintended state changes ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) , while recent work examines corrupt success, silent failures, and process-level defects ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Advani, 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) . These checks provide progress, state-integrity, or process-quality measures.A related line of work diagnoses failures after the fact, labelling trajectories by cause and attributing each failure to the step where the run first departs from a valid solution ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025b ; Barke et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Async-RBench instead scores the response to each target event against an ERC written for that event and reports DRS separately from task success.
paragraphs.zh: 许多智能体基准测试提出任务并强调任务层面的结果，涵盖通用辅助（Liu et al., 2024；Mialon et al., 2024）、网页与移动界面（Zhou et al., 2024；Koh et al., 2024；Drouin et al., 2024；Rawles et al., 2025）、与用户协同的工具使用（Yao et al., 2024；Barres et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026a），以及长上下文或基于 MCP 的工作流（Li et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2025）。 多智能体基准测试将其扩展到智能体之间的协作与竞争（Zhu et al., 2025a），以及在确定性仿真中评估的编排计划（Ren et al., 2026）。 其他基准测试提供了补充性的检查。 AgentBoard 衡量中间进度（Ma et al., 2024），ToolSandbox 检查轨迹中的里程碑（Lu et al., 2024），AppWorld 检查非预期的状态变更（Trivedi et al., 2024），而近期工作则考察虚假成功、静默失败和过程级缺陷（Cao et al., 2026；Advani, 2026；He et al., 2026）。 这些检查提供了进度、状态完整性或过程质量方面的度量。另一条相关工作线路是在事后诊断失败，按原因对轨迹进行标注，并将每次失败归因于运行首次偏离有效解的那一步（Cemri et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025b；Barke et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b）。 Async-RBench 则针对每个目标事件，依据为该事件编写的 ERC 对响应进行评分，并将 DRS 与任务成功分开报告。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent frameworks give separate agents distinct roles and conversational contexts ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) , and Magentic-One uses an orchestrator that plans, tracks progress, and replans to recover from errors ( Fourney et al., 2024 ) . Masters et al. (2025) frame such orchestration by a manager agent as a unifying research challenge. Single-agent loops such as ReAct interleave reasoning and actions with observations from the environment ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . LLMCompiler dispatches tool calls in parallel once their dependencies are resolved, passes their outputs to dependent calls, and replans by sending intermediate results back to the planner ( Kim et al., 2024 ) . On the benchmark side, Gaia2 evaluates agents in independently evolving environments under time constraints ( Froger et al., 2026 ) , Robotouille studies asynchronous planning under execution delays ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ) , and ClawArena and SentinelBench cover evolving information and long-running monitoring ( Ji et al., 2026 ; Maldaner et al., 2026 ) . Other work studies user requirement changes ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Rana et al., 2025 ) , interruptions during reasoning ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , paused or handed-over execution ( Gulati, 2026 ; KC & Budathoki, 2026 ) , or injected tool and delegation failures ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) , and HANDRAISER learns when an agent should interrupt a peer ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . AgentChangeBench also reports shift-level recovery metrics ( Rana et al., 2025 ) . A subagent result need not itself require a plan change. It may be authoritative, stale, duplicated, or partial, and the correct response may be to keep existing work unchanged. The closest benchmark, ClawArena-Team, evaluates how a main agent delegates to a fixed subagent pool, assigns permissions, and integrates results ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) , but it does not define a separate response contract for each subagent-result event. paragraphs.en: Async-RBench addresses both evaluation obstacles identified in Section 1 : controlled delivery applies predefined release conditions (Section 3.1 ), and per-event contracts score the response separately from task success (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: Async-RBench 同时解决了第 1 节中指出的两个评估障碍：受控交付采用预定义的发布条件（第 3.1 节），而逐事件契约将响应评分与任务成功分开评估（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each case specifies the subagent workloads, the relations among their results (e.g., one result supersedes, duplicates, or conflicts with another), and the conditions for presenting each result to Main. These conditions depend on observable task progress, such as which results Main has already received and which artifacts exist, and are designed so that the prior work referenced by an ERC is generally available when its event is presented. In Figure 2 , if B or C finishes before A, its result is buffered until A has been presented in an earlier Main request. Async adds at most one new result to each Main request. After a result is presented,the main agent receives a handling window of at least one and, by default, at most four responses; subsequent results remain queued until this window closes. To prevent indefinite blocking, the controller releases a result once its maximum hold time is reached and logs the fallback release (Appendix C.1).
paragraphs.zh: 每种情形规定了各智能体的工作负载、其结果之间的关系（例如某一结果取代、重复或与另一结果冲突），以及将每个结果呈现给 Main 的条件。 这些条件取决于可观察的任务进展，例如 Main 已经收到哪些结果以及存在哪些工件，并且其设计确保在某个 ERC 的事件被呈现时，该 ERC 所引用的先前工作通常已经可用。 在图 2 中，如果 B 或 C 在 A 之前完成，其结果会被缓冲，直到 A 在更早的 Main 请求中已被呈现。 Async 在每个 Main 请求中最多添加一个新结果。 在一个结果被呈现后，主智能体会收到一个处理窗口，包含至少一个、默认情况下至多四个响应；后续结果保持排队状态，直到该窗口关闭。 为防止无限期阻塞，控制器在结果达到其最长保留时间后即释放该结果，并记录这次回退释放（附录 C.1）。

paragraphs.en: Scoring both process and outcome distinguishes cases that task success alone conflates. A run that reaches the required outcome through a prohibited action loses process credit, while a run that fails to reach that outcome can still earn credit for satisfied process requirements. paragraphs.en: An LLM agent screens source tasks and traces, with fixed versions and environments, for decision points at which a delegated result could change an earlier decision. Researchers then check the basis of that decision, the validity of the new result, and its effect on existing work, design the subagent workflows, result contents, and release conditions (introducing an event where the source task has none), and derive the ERC from the artifacts expected before the event, the scope the result affects, and the evidence validation must produce. Evaluated agents never see the source traces. Before admission, trial runs check that events trigger in the intended state, reference and equivalent solutions check solvability and that verifiers accept equivalent valid solutions, and invalid variants (e.g., omitted revisions, incorrect rollbacks, duplicated side effects) check that verifiers reject them (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Our main setting, asynchronous delivery (Async), presents results individually while the main agent continues working, following the release rules in Section 3.1 . The baseline, batched delivery (Batched), presents all results together after every required subagent workflow terminates. Both modes run subagents concurrently with the same tasks, workflows, and resource limits, but use different result-delivery protocols. We report DRS for Async and task success S S for both modes. Because subagents are executed independently in the two modes, their outputs and the main agent’s subsequent actions may differ across runs.

paragraphs.en: Each agent is evaluated on all 200 tasks three times per delivery mode, yielding 600 runs per agent per mode. Each run allows at most 100 main-agent responses and 40 responses per subagent execution. Each response is capped at 16,384 output tokens, and at most three subagents run concurrently. A run ends when the main agent calls finish , responds without a tool call, exhausts its budget, or reaches 2,400 seconds. Runs affected by infrastructure failures are rerun (Appendix ). For each scenario, we report the mean and sample SD of its three repetition-level mean scores.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体在全部 200 个任务上按每种交付模式各评估三次，即每个智能体每种模式产生 600 次运行。 两种模式下的运行按任务和重复索引配对，并匹配相同的环境、任务与验证器版本以及模型配置。 每次运行最多允许主智能体响应 100 次，且每个子智能体执行最多响应 40 次。 每次响应的输出上限为 16,384 个 token，且最多同时运行三个子智能体。 当主智能体调用 finish、在没有工具调用的情况下作出响应、耗尽其预算或达到 2,400 秒时，运行即告结束。 受基础设施故障影响的运行会重新执行（附录 ）。 对于每个场景，我们报告其三次重复级别平均得分的均值和样本标准差。

paragraphs.en: For Terra, Luna, and Gemini, which rank high, middle, and low in Table 3 , we score three conditions from the same pre-event state (artifacts, main-agent context, subagent states, and event content) under the same limits, ERCs, and scoring rules. Native lets the main agent respond freely, as in the main experiment. After the target result is presented, Frozen replays a continuation generated by the same model without access to that result. Oracle executes a reference recovery program written for that event. As shown in Figure 4 , for all three agents, DRS is lowest for Frozen (3.7–16.1), higher for Native (19.2–39.7), and highest for Oracle (96.4–98.8). This ordering shows that DRS distinguishes responses informed by the target result from continuations generated without it. The near-ceiling Oracle scores show that the evaluated ERCs can be satisfied. Oracle knows each event’s requirements, so it is a reference rather than a capability-matched baseline. Frozen earns some credit because unadapted actions can still preserve valid work or avoid prohibited side effects.

paragraphs.en: Scores are lowest on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Averaged across agents, DRS is 8.6 on Duplication and replay and 12.2 on Subagent failure, compared with 57.5 on Scope and dependencies and 60.7 on Resource stragglers. The ERCs for the two lowest-scoring scenarios emphasize preserving valid work and avoiding unnecessary side effects. A duplicate report adds no new evidence, while a subagent failure requires recovering the affected subtask without disturbing valid work elsewhere. These averages also include zero scores from valid runs in which the main agent terminates before receiving the target result, and the scenarios use different source tasks. The score gaps therefore do not, by themselves, establish that preserving valid work is the main source of difficulty.

paragraphs.en: Rankings shift across scenarios and differ from task success. sents.en: DRS is also complementary to task success: Qwen3.7 Plus ranks third on DRS but seventh on asynchronous S S (Table 4 ), whereas DeepSeek V4 Pro ranks sixth and third.

sents.en: Across agents, more model calls do not necessarily correspond to higher DRS: Terra scores 39.7 with 48.1 calls per run, whereas Kimi K2.5 scores 26.1 with 125.2 calls (Appendix ).

paragraphs.en: Where responses fail. Following prior failure taxonomies ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) and trace-based diagnosis ( Zhu et al., 2025b ; Barke et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) , we label issues in a sample of 106 Async runs (Figure 4 ; excerpts in Appendix ). Unreliable verification is the most common label; one example is a test that prints a failure message but does not signal failure. Other examples include using a deferred result (execution-state confusion), fabricating a missing receipt (goal drift), presenting static code analysis as runtime coverage (evidence distortion), and accepting plans that pass local checks but jointly exceed a task-wide budget (missed global constraints).
paragraphs.zh: 响应失败之处。 参照先前的失败分类法（Cemri et al., 2025）和基于轨迹的诊断（Zhu et al., 2025b; Barke et al., 2026; Chen et al., 2026b），我们对 106 个 Async 运行的样本中的问题进行了标注（图 4；摘录见附录）。 不可靠的验证是最常见的标签；一个例子是某测试仅打印失败消息却未发出失败信号。 其他例子包括使用延迟结果（执行状态混淆）、伪造缺失的回执（目标漂移）、将静态代码分析呈现为运行时覆盖率（证据扭曲），以及接受那些通过局部检查但合计超出任务级预算的计划（遗漏全局约束）。

paragraphs.en: Under our execution protocol, all nine systems obtain lower task-success point estimates with asynchronous than with batched delivery, by 1.0–6.0 percentage points (Table 4 ), and the mean falls from 29.7% to 26.0%. Eight of the nine also consume more tokens, and main-agent consumption rises in all nine (Figure 5 ); for Terra it doubles while subagent consumption barely changes (Appendix ). Paired traces of tasks solved only under batched delivery illustrate two observed failure paths, without establishing that asynchronous delivery caused them.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的执行协议下，所有九个系统在异步交付下的任务成功率点估计均低于批量交付，差距为1.0–6.0个百分点（表4），平均值从29.7%降至26.0%。 九个系统中有八个消耗的令牌也更多，且所有九个系统的主智能体消耗均上升（图5）；对于Terra，其消耗翻倍而子智能体的消耗几乎不变（附录）。 仅在批量交付下解决的任务的成对轨迹展示了两种观察到的失败路径，但并不能证明是异步交付导致了这些问题。

paragraphs.en: Ending before required artifacts are integrated. In a Conflicting results scheduling task, Qwen3.5 27B receives a validation report under asynchronous delivery while the second plan set still sits in another subagent’s workspace. The main agent emits its final answer, and shutdown cancels that subagent before it delivers the plans, so the terminal checks find the plan set and the decision manifest missing; the batched run receives both plan sets and passes.

paragraphs.en: Under Native execution, the main agent decides for itself whether and how to revise its plan when a result arrives. Full-rebuild instead instructs the main agent to rebuild the entire remaining plan from the current task state whenever a subagent result is presented, keeping completed work and existing artifacts. We run it on Terra, Luna, and Gemini, separately from the main experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 在原生（Native）执行方式下，主智能体在结果到达时自行决定是否以及如何修订其计划。 全量重建（Full-rebuild）则指示主智能体在每次收到子智能体结果时，根据当前任务状态重建整个剩余计划，同时保留已完成的工作和已有的产出物。 我们在 Terra、Luna 和 Gemini 上运行它，与主实验分开进行。

sents.zh: 在原生（Native）执行方式下，主智能体在结果到达时自行决定是否以及如何修订其计划。

sents.en: Full-rebuild instead instructs the main agent to rebuild the entire remaining plan from the current task state whenever a subagent result is presented, keeping completed work and existing artifacts.
sents.zh: 全量重建（Full-rebuild）则指示主智能体在每次收到子智能体结果时，根据当前任务状态重建整个剩余计划，同时保留已完成的工作和已有的产出物。

sents.en: We run it on Terra, Luna, and Gemini, separately from the main experiment.

paragraphs.en: Full-rebuild raises DRS on all three agents (Figure 6 a), from 39.7 to 42.3 for Terra, 31.1 to 34.6 for Luna, and 19.2 to 21.9 for Gemini, while mean model calls per run increase by 7.5–10.2% (Figure 6 b). The additional calls occur mainly in the main agent for Terra and Luna and are distributed roughly evenly between the main agent and subagents for Gemini. Thus, the Full-rebuild instruction yields modest DRS gains at additional computational cost. Because we do not report whether agents actually rebuild their plans as instructed, the results cannot distinguish failures to follow the instruction from errors that persist after rebuilding.
paragraphs.zh: 全重建在三个智能体上均提升了 DRS（图 6 a），Terra 从 39.7 提升至 42.3，Luna 从 31.1 提升至 34.6，Gemini 从 19.2 提升至 21.9，同时每次运行的平均模型调用次数增加 7.5–10.2%（图 6 b）。 额外的调用主要发生在 Terra 和 Luna 的主智能体中，而在 Gemini 中则大致均匀地分布在主智能体与子智能体之间。 因此，全重建指令以额外的计算成本带来了适度的 DRS 提升。 由于我们并未报告各智能体是否实际按指示重建了其计划，因此这些结果无法区分是未能遵循指令，还是重建之后依然存在的错误。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Async-RBench to evaluate how LLM agents handle subagent results asynchronously. Controlled delivery and event-specific contracts allow response quality to be scored separately from final task success. Across nine agents, DRS reaches at most 45.1 and is lowest on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents have lower task-success point estimates with asynchronous than with batched delivery. For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6–3.5 points while increasing model calls by 7.5–10.2%. These findings motivate strategies that track which work a result affects and which remains valid, evaluated through both event responses and end-to-end task success.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Async-RBench，用于评估大语言模型智能体如何异步处理子智能体结果。 受控交付与事件特定契约使响应质量可以与最终任务成功分开评分。 在九个智能体中，DRS 最高达到 45.1，在重复报告和子智能体失败两类事件上最低。 在我们的执行协议下，全部九个智能体在异步交付下的任务成功点估计都低于批量交付。 对于其中三个智能体，促使主智能体在收到每个结果后重建其计划，仅能将 DRS 提高 2.6–3.5 分，同时使模型调用增加 7.5–10.2%。 这些发现启发我们设计能够追踪某个结果影响了哪些工作、哪些仍然有效的策略，并通过事件响应和端到端任务成功两个层面加以评估。

paragraphs.en: Each task isolates one target event, excluding overlaps. DRS conservatively scores valid runs terminating before target delivery as zero, conflating them with response errors. Controller-based delivery with timeout fallback is reproducible but may not reflect real arrivals. Main and subagents share one model, favoring comparability over heterogeneity. Independent subagent runs introduce variation into delivery-timing comparisons. Human-written ERCs and verifiers may omit valid responses despite sampled human review.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务隔离一个目标事件，排除重叠情况。 DRS 将在目标送达前终止的有效运行保守地评为零分，将其与响应错误混为一谈。 基于控制器的送达加超时回退机制是可复现的，但可能无法反映真实的到达情况。 主智能体与子智能体共享同一个模型，优先考虑可比性而非异构性。 独立的子智能体运行给送达时间比较引入了变异性。 人工编写的 ERC 和验证器尽管经过抽样人工审查，仍可能遗漏有效响应。

paragraphs.en: In this work, LLM agents are the object of study: the analyzed trajectories and trained checkpoints are produced by the agents themselves and are reported as experimental results. As authors, we used generative AI tools for tasks requiring disclosure: producing initial annotation labels for trajectory analysis, distilling open-source documentation into the skill library, and assisting with implementing the framework and analysis code. We also used generative AI tools for drafting and polishing text, creating figures, and formatting references. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: all labels were manually audited, and all code was verified and tested by the authors. We take responsibility for the final content of this work.

paragraphs.en: Sections 3 and 4 elaborate on the full benchmark framework, evaluation metrics, execution modes, model configurations, run budgets, and aggregation procedures. Appendix A documents task sources, case construction workflows, scenario specifications, and verifier acceptance criteria; Appendix presents representative cases for all eight scenarios; Appendix specifies result delivery boundaries, termination and rerun rules, cost accounting conventions, and execution and scoring versioning; and Appendix provides the trajectory evidence underlying the failure analysis. The supplementary material includes the benchmark implementation code, case specification files, verifiers, configuration files, and run manifests, with each analyzed run uniquely tied to its model identifier, configuration parameters, test case, verifier, and protocol version, while private verifier data, access credentials, and license-restricted assets are excluded from the public release package.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节和第 4 节详细阐述了完整的基准测试框架、评估指标、执行模式、模型配置、运行预算以及汇总流程。 附录 A 记录了任务来源、用例构建流程、场景规范以及验证器验收标准；附录展示了全部八个场景的代表性用例；附录规定了结果交付边界、终止与重跑规则、成本核算约定以及执行与评分版本管理；附录还提供了支撑失败分析的轨迹证据。 补充材料包括基准测试实现代码、用例规范文件、验证器、配置文件和运行清单，每个被分析的运行都唯一地关联到其模型标识符、配置参数、测试用例、验证器和协议版本，而私有验证器数据、访问凭据以及受许可限制的资产则被排除在公开发布包之外。

paragraphs.en: This work introduces Async-RBench, a benchmark for evaluating asynchronous task execution in LLM agents. The study does not involve human subjects, sensitive personal data, or potentially harmful applications. All source tasks are adapted from publicly available, previously published benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, Gaia2, OSWorld, SWE-bench, and MultiAgentBench) in compliance with their respective usage licenses.

paragraphs.en: Construction begins by fixing the source version, task identifier, and initial environment, and checking that the task has an explicit objective, an executable workflow, and a verifiable final state. An LLM agent then flags decision points that subagent results may affect; its suggestions only support screening. Researchers examine information dependencies to identify work that can be delegated and the plans, artifacts, or checks that new results may affect, and they determine the scenario labels and scoring requirements. They then design the subagent workflows, result contents, version relations, release conditions, and event timeline, and write the Event Response Contract (ERC). Human review checks that the source evidence, the validity of the new result, its task consequences, and the scoring requirements agree; a candidate becomes an executable instance only when it is clear which work must be revised, preserved, or revalidated after the event. Figure 7 summarizes the process, and Appendix A.5 describes execution acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 构建始于固定源版本、任务标识符和初始环境，并检查该任务是否具有明确的目标、可执行的工作流程以及可验证的最终状态。 随后，LLM 智能体会标记出子智能体结果可能影响的决策点；其建议仅用于辅助筛选。 研究人员检查信息依赖关系，以识别可以委托的工作，以及新结果可能影响的计划、产物或检查项，并确定场景标签和评分要求。 然后他们设计子智能体的工作流程、结果内容、版本关系、发布条件和事件时间线，并撰写事件响应契约（ERC）。 人工审核检查源证据、新结果的有效性、其对任务的后果以及评分要求是否一致；只有当明确事件发生后哪些工作必须修订、保留或重新验证时，候选方案才能成为可执行实例。 图 7 总结了该流程，附录 A.5 描述了执行验收。

paragraphs.en: The construction set contains 47 tasks, and the evaluation set contains 200 tasks, with no overlap between them. The evaluation set covers eight scenarios with 25 tasks each and five original sources with 40 tasks each. Its 200 tasks comprise 621 initial subtasks: 36.5% of tasks start with two subagents, 20.0% with three, and 43.5% with four or more, and 52.0% are rated medium and 48.0% hard.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation weights tasks equally, without additional scenario weights. paragraphs.en: Human review during construction checks that task requirements are clear, required inputs are available, and scoring conditions match the task objectives. Following work that assesses automatic trajectory evaluators against expert judgments ( Lù et al., 2025 ) , we also audit the verifiers. We randomly sampled 405 run records from the evaluation set. Auditors examined task requirements, initial states, presented results, trajectories, tool outputs, and final artifacts; a model’s completion claim alone was never taken as evidence of success. A verifier decision counts as a false rejection if the auditor judges an artifact valid but the verifier rejects it, and as a missed violation in the opposite case. In the initial audit, item-level agreement between human judgments and automated decisions was 96.6%. Every disagreement traced to external infrastructure failures; no task-design issue was found in the sample. We then screened all run records across models, modes, and repetitions for the same anomaly types, fixed the environment, and reran all affected runs. The reruns passed run-validity checks and replaced the affected records, while task failures attributable to the models were retained. These conclusions apply to the audited sample and versions; they do not establish that the verifiers have no false rejections or missed violations.
paragraphs.zh: 构建过程中的人工审核检查任务要求是否清晰、所需输入是否可用，以及评分条件是否与任务目标一致。 继衡量自动轨迹评估器与专家判断一致性的工作（Lù et al., 2025）之后，我们也对验证器进行了审计。 我们从评估集中随机抽取了405条运行记录。 审计员检查了任务要求、初始状态、呈现的结果、轨迹、工具输出和最终产出物；模型声称完成本身绝不作为成功的证据。 如果审计员判定某个产出物有效但验证器将其拒绝，则该验证器的决定计为一次错误拒绝；反之则计为一次漏检违规。 在初次审计中，人工判断与自动决策在条目层面的一致率为96.6%。 每一处不一致都可追溯至外部基础设施故障；在该样本中未发现任务设计问题。 随后我们跨模型、模式和重复次数筛查了所有运行记录中的同类异常，修复了环境，并重新运行了所有受影响的运行。 重跑通过了运行有效性检查并替换了受影响的记录，而可归因于模型本身的任务失败则予以保留。 这些结论仅适用于被审计的样本和版本；它们并不能证明验证器不存在错误拒绝或漏检违规。

paragraphs.en: The eight scenarios are organized by result validity, information completeness, task dependencies, and execution scheduling. Each instance has one primary scenario label and may require revision, preservation, avoidance of forbidden changes, and revalidation. The label describes the principal event relation; task evidence and dependencies determine the specific response requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 这八个场景按结果有效性、信息完整性、任务依赖性和执行调度进行组织。 每个实例都有一个主要场景标签，并且可能需要修订、保留、避免禁止的更改以及重新验证。 该标签描述主要的事件关系；任务证据和依赖关系决定具体的响应要求。

paragraphs.en: In Delayed authority , the main agent progresses using provisional information before a result arrives that supersedes or corrects it, requiring revision of the affected work. In Staleness and ordering , an older result is presented after a newer state has taken effect; the main agent must recognize the version relation and avoid rolling back valid state. In Conflicting results , outputs from valid workflows support different conclusions; the main agent must resolve them using provenance, scope, and task constraints. Duplication and replay requires idempotent handling of repeated results, avoiding duplicate writes, repeated submissions, or unnecessary rebuilding.
paragraphs.zh: 在「延迟授权」（Delayed authority）中，主智能体在结果到达之前使用临时信息推进，随后该结果可能取代或修正先前信息，因此需要修订受影响的工作。 在「过期与排序」（Staleness and ordering）中，较旧的结果在较新的状态已生效之后才呈现；主智能体必须识别版本关系，避免回滚有效的状态。 在「结果冲突」（Conflicting results）中，来自有效工作流的输出支持不同的结论；主智能体必须依据来源（provenance）、范围和任务约束来解决这些冲突。 「重复与重放」（Duplication and replay）要求对重复结果进行幂等处理，避免重复写入、重复提交或不必要的重建。

paragraphs.en: Partial to complete presents local evidence or an intermediate artifact before the full result. The main agent must distinguish provisional information from completion evidence and complete integration and validation once the full result arrives. In Subagent failure , a subagent fails to complete its assigned work, reports failure, or declines further execution. The main agent must recover the affected subtask while preserving valid work completed by other subagents.
paragraphs.zh: 「部分到完整」指在完整结果到来之前，先呈现局部证据或中间产物。 主智能体必须区分临时信息与完成证据，并在完整结果到达后完成整合与验证。 在「子智能体失败」中，子智能体未能完成其被分配的工作、报告失败，或拒绝继续执行。 主智能体必须恢复受影响的子任务，同时保留其他子智能体已完成的有效工作。

sents.zh: 在「子智能体失败」中，子智能体未能完成其被分配的工作、报告失败，或拒绝继续执行。

sents.en: The main agent must recover the affected subtask while preserving valid work completed by other subagents.
sents.zh: 主智能体必须恢复受影响的子任务，同时保留其他子智能体已完成的有效工作。

paragraphs.en: Scope and dependencies requires the main agent to propagate changes in scope, dependency relations, or acceptance conditions to the relevant artifacts and checks while preserving unrelated work. Resource stragglers combines delayed critical results with changing resource constraints. The main agent must use task dependencies to choose among waiting, cancellation, reassignment, and continued execution while preserving valid completed state.
paragraphs.zh: Scope and dependencies 要求主智能体在范围、依赖关系或验收条件发生变化时，将这些变化传播到相关的工件和检查中，同时保留无关的工作。 Resource stragglers 将延迟的关键结果与不断变化的资源约束相结合。 主智能体必须利用任务依赖关系，在等待、取消、重新分配和继续执行之间做出选择，同时保留有效的已完成状态。

paragraphs.en: One event may impose several response requirements. For example, a late authoritative result may require revising one dependent file, preserving unaffected test results, and rerunning the relevant checks on the updated state. The ERC therefore translates scenario relations into specific revision scope, preservation requirements, and validation evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 一个事件可能提出多项响应要求。 例如，一个迟到的权威结果可能要求修订一个受依赖的文件、保留未受影响的测试结果，并在更新后的状态上重新运行相关检查。 因此，ERC 将场景关系转化为具体的修订范围、保留要求和验证证据。
